<thought>Based on the mass (M⁺ = 194.09), the ¹H NMR (four aromatic protons in an AA′BB′ pattern, a multiplet integrating to 10 H at 1.35 ppm and a single proton at 2.63 ppm), the most plausible structure is para‑diethyl‑acetophenone: a para‑substituted benzene bearing a carbonyl group (‑CO‑) attached to a carbon bearing two ethyl groups (‑C(Et)₂‑H). This fits the formula C₁₁H₁₄O (M = 194.09) and the observed NMR pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(C(=O)C1=CC=C(C)C=C1)CC</final_answer>
